newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices rise, volume down sharply.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices rise, volume down sharply.

text.p: Gold prices firmed on Istanbul's gold exchange on Tuesday in line with world trends but volume plunged on slack demand, dealers said.
Gold closed at $382.50 an ounce and 1,119,900 lira per gram, up from Monday's $381.85 and 1,116,000 lira.
But traded volume tumbled to 416 kilos from Monday's 1,690 on weak free market demand. This reflected a continuing cash squeeze and higher international gold prices.
"There was some demand in the morning but rising prices reduced demand and the market was very quiet in the afternoon," said Yusuf Kiremitci at Sembol Doviz.
The bulk of trade -- 406 kilos -- was in the morning.
Some 210 kilos were traded in dollar terms and 206 in lira.
